title: Delibir-dy
description: The {{delibirdName}}s are looking at you expectantly, as if they want something. Perhaps giving them a relic or some money would satisfy them?
invalidSelection: This Mogger Mon doesn’t have that kind of item.

1.label: Give Money
1.tooltip:
(-) Give the {{delibirdName}}s {{money, money}}
(+) Receive a Gift Relic
1.selected:
You toss the money to the {{delibirdName}}s,
who chatter amongst themselves excitedly.$They turn back to you and happily give you a present!

2.label: Give Food
2.tooltip:
(-) Give the {{delibirdName}}s a Zaza or Reviver Seed
(+) Receive a Gift Relic
2.selected:
You toss the {{chosenItem}} to the {{delibirdName}}s,
who chatter amongst themselves excitedly.$They turn back to you and happily give you a present!

3.label: Give an Relic
3.tooltip:
(-) Give the {{delibirdName}}s a Held Relic
(+) Receive a Gift Relic
3.selected:
You toss the {{chosenItem}} to the {{delibirdName}}s,
who chatter amongst themselves excitedly.$They turn back to you and happily give you a present!

outro: The {{delibirdName}} flock happily waddles off into the distance.$What a curious little exchange!
